From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Security posture & subprocessor next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap + suggested next steps from our side so we can keep procurement and security moving: 

Summary from call:
- MedBridge workflows: user-uploaded clinical notes + real-time inference for triage rules; persistent embeddings stored for search.
- Key asks: SOC 2 status, GDPR data residency for EU patients, HIPAA BA considerations, and a roster of subprocessors that will touch PHI/PII.

Items we can action now:
1) Subprocessor roster: can you share the list of cloud vendors and any downstream processors that will receive or store data? If you have a CSV export, perfect — otherwise a short list works.
2) SOC 2: please share current status (Type I/II, audit vendor, date).
3) Security contact: point us to the best person to run the questionnaire and a good time window for a short vendor-risk call.

I attached a short questionnaire template and a CSV template (see attachments) to make the roster easy to export on your side. Proposed timeline: roster + SOC2 details by Wed (5/26), questionnaire kickoff the week of 5/31, security call as needed.

Let me know if that timeline is realistic and whether you prefer Redwood to open the questionnaire in your vendor portal or send our template directly.

Thanks —
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Moroz <elena@medbridgehealth.com>

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security posture & subprocessor next steps

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick notes from our security team: 

- Subprocessors: I attached our current vendor roster export (subprocessor_roster.csv). Major entries: AWS (us-east-1), Algolia (search indexing), Segment (events routing), Postgres hosting via Heroku). The CSV flags which vendors may see PII/PHI.
- SOC 2: We are currently undergoing a Type II audit; auditor is Harlow & Co; report expected late Q3 2027. We have a Type I from 2025.
- HIPAA: We operate under a BA with customers; for vendors that touch PHI we require a vendor BA where applicable.

Security contact: forward questionnaire to security@medbridgehealth.com — they typically triage and will invite a subject-matter expert. If helpful, I'm available to join the kickoff call.

Next steps from our side: I'll push the roster to security and they will confirm whether any vendor redlines are needed. If you can send the questionnaire directly, that will speed things up.

Regards,
Elena
Director, Clinical Products | MedBridge Health
attachments: subprocessor_roster.csv (text/csv)

Team — forwarding Elena's roster and notes. Quick internal plan and asks so we can move fast on qualification: 

What Elena provided:
- CSV roster (attached) enumerates cloud providers and downstream services. Flags PHI exposure for a subset.
- SOC2 Type II expected Q3 (audit firm Harlow & Co).

Our asks / owners:
- Grace: can you own the vendor risk intake for the flagged vendors (Algolia, Segment, Heroku)? Specifically we need:
  * confirmation on whether data is encrypted at rest and in transit (TLS 1.2+),
  * whether any vendor stores persistent embeddings or user-submitted documents, and
  * whether they sign a BA when PHI is present.
- Aditya: please prepare the Redwood security questionnaire (use our template) and a short cover note; send it to security@medbridgehealth.com and CC Elena. Ask for answers by EOD 5/31.
- I'll coordinate a 30-min vendor-risk call if they prefer a sync.

Proposed timeline:
- 5/25: Redwood sends questionnaire + coversheet.
- 5/31: MedBridge returns questionnaire answers / follow-up flags.
- Early June: vendor-risk call if there are any open items.

Elena — copying you so Grace/Aditya can connect directly. Grace/Aditya — any objections or additions?

Thanks,
Karthik
